MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Command hooks fit the hanging purpose of my recent magnetic hook purchases, so I could see their usefulness even though I would pass now.",
    "Practical fastening and hanging supplies connect with my recent purchases of washers, screws, nuts, and hooks."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors, switches, heat shrink tubing, and resistors assume an electrical project that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "Spray bottles and jewelry cleaning supplies do not serve the fastening or hanging purposes reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "I have no specific gluing task in mind, and ten tubes of super glue would be more than I currently need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been taken as interest in supplies for almost any repair project.",
    "My screw assortment purchase seems to have been treated as evidence that I also need electronic components and large electrical assortments."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I recently bought two magnetic hook sets, so another hook purchase can fit my interests without being something I need now.",
    "I rarely interact unless an item addresses a clear need; being broadly useful around a home or workshop is not enough.",
    "The purpose of an item matters more to me than its resemblance to other hardware supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastening and hanging interests but stretched them into unrelated projects and missed that my recent hook purchases may already cover that need."
}
